title: Right-hand p-i-m-a across open strings
description: A classical right-hand arpeggio pattern: thumb (p) on the open low E, then i-m-a on the open G, B and high E strings. Every note is an open string, so the left hand is silent and the only annotation of interest is fingering with hand: right — the p/i/m/a vocabulary that MusicXML keeps in a separate <pluck> element but v5 unifies under one fingering object. The renderer does not draw fingering yet; the goldens pin the open-string zeros on the tab staff.
